description: Yousaf Weaving Mills Limited is engaged in the business of textile weaving and manufacturing quality yarn from raw cotton as well as synthetic fibre, and in the sale of processed fabric. The company was incorporated on 17 January 1988 as a public limited company in Pakistan and is quoted on the Pakistan Stock Exchange, with its registered office at 7/1, E-3, Main Boulevard Gulberg III, Lahore.
